text.en: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12", have +1 S. If your army includes a VULKAN HE’STAN unit, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units have the following: When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move,…
Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to: BS. WS. Hit rolls.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1 D.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model’s melee attacks have: +1 S. +1 D.
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit’s [TORRENT] weapons have +1 A.
